title: observability: token-level metrics/tracing dashboard + alert refinements
author: Ava Martinez
description: This PR adds refinements to the token-level observability surface: expanded KV cache and per-token cost/latency panels, improved tracing spans for request routing and KV lookups, and tuned alerting rules to reduce noise. Motivation: over the last quarter we saw spiky alert noise (INC-874) and gaps in understanding where token-level costs were accumulating for multi-turn chats. Changes include dashboard layout updates, new PromQL metrics, additional tracing tags, structured logging fields for cache events, and alert threshold adjustments with runbook links. The description below summarizes commits, files changed, review discussion, and CI results.
commits: c1a2f3e: add token_cost_per_route and token_latency_per_route metrics (exporter)
d4b5e6f: emit kv_cache.hit/miss spans and structured log fields
f7a8b9c: dashboard: token-level Cost/Latency + KV Cache panels and drilldowns
a1b2c3d: alerts: lower false-positive noise by switching from 5m to 15m window + add severity labels
e4f5g6h: tests: unit tests for exporter metric names + integration smoke for alert rules
files_changed: services/metrics-exporter/src/main.rs (adds token_cost_per_route, token_latency_per_route gauges and labels)
services/serving/src/kv_cache/tracing.rs (emit span kv_cache.lookup with fields {key_hash, hit:boolean, backend})
services/serving/src/logging.rs (structured json fields: kv_hit, kv_latency_ms, route_id, user_tier)
infra/monitoring/dashboards/token_observability.json (new dashboard with Cost/Latency panels, KV cache breakdowns, per-route drilldowns)
review_comments: Ethan Chen (reviewer): Please justify switching token-cost alert window from 5m to 15m in the PR description and include expected impact on MTTA.

Ava Martinez (author): Updated alerts to 15m window and added severity labels; rationale: per our incident postmortem the 5m window produced transient spikes tied to batching; 15m reduces noise and matches customer-visible SLO windows. Added runbook with mitigation steps and estimated MTTA improvement of ~30%.

Priya Singh (reviewer): KV cache spans look good. Can we include the cache backend in the span tags for easier filtering (e.g., local vs remote)? Also request a short unit test that asserts the kv_hit boolean is emitted.

Ava Martinez (author): Added backend tag to kv_cache.lookup span and added unit tests in tests/metrics/test_exporter.rs that assert kv_hit and backend labels are present. Note: instrumentation is noop-cost when disabled by config.

Liam O'Connor (reviewer): Dashboard panels look good. Small nit: change panel title 'Token Cost / Route' -> 'Token cost per route (USD/token)' to make units explicit. Also request a Grafana link in docs.
Ava Martinez (author): Renamed panel and added dashboard URL in docs/observability/token_metrics.md. Responded to nit and pushed final dashboard JSON.
Ethan Chen (approver): Approved after tests green and runbook link added.
release_notes:
- Added token-level cost and latency metrics for per-route breakdowns.
- Emitted KV cache hit/miss spans and structured logging fields for improved troubleshooting.
- New Grafana dashboard for token observability with drilldowns.
- Tuned alerts to reduce false positives (5m -> 15m windows) and added severity labels and runbooks.
